author: Animalogic
description:
With their enormous glowing eyes, tiny beaks, and perfectly camouflaged bodies, potoos are masters of disguise. By day, they freeze in place, blending seamlessly into tree stumps. But when darkness falls, they transform into silent night hunters, swooping through the forest in search of insects. Their eerie calls echo through the rainforest, giving them a reputation as “ghost birds” of the jungle.
